_doc: Owner-approved corrections (2026-11-27), each checked against the ITIL Foundation Version 5 Official Book. Every corrected question is labelled 'معدّل' (corrected) in the app, cites the book section, and keeps the original source text in question.correction.original. Applied by tools/audit/build_bank.py before duplicate analysis.

corrections.summary: Answer key changed C -> A. 'Start where you are' asks for objective observation, e.g. people with no prior knowledge of the service ('fresh eyes'). Same question as printed #105 (key A); this copy then becomes an identical duplicate.
corrections.summaryAr: تغيّرت الإجابة من C إلى A حسب الكتاب 5.2.2 (الملاحظة الموضوعية بعيون جديدة).

corrections.summary: Option C was printed as a second 'Warranty'; replaced by 'User experience', the fourth of the book's four concepts (utility, warranty, user experience, sustainability).
corrections.summaryAr: الخيار C كان مكرراً «Warranty»، وصار «User experience» حسب الكتاب 3.2.4.

corrections.summary: Truncated option 'Product Vend' completed as 'Product Vendor' (the book's digital product vendor role).
corrections.summaryAr: الخيار المقطوع «Product Vend» اكتمل إلى «Product Vendor» حسب الكتاب 3.2.1.

corrections.summary: Removed the stray editorial line 'Add answer: D. The external partner providing technology.'; key C (sponsor authorizes the budget) confirmed.
corrections.summaryAr: حُذف السطر الزائد «Add answer»، والإجابة C صحيحة حسب الكتاب 3.2.1.1.

corrections.summary: ITIL 4 term 'service value system' renamed to the Version 5 term 'ITIL Value System'.
corrections.summaryAr: تحديث المصطلح القديم «service value system» إلى «ITIL Value System» (الكتاب 5.1).

corrections.summaryAr: تحديث المصطلح القديم إلى «dimension of product and service management» (الكتاب 2.1).

corrections.summary: Answer key changed A -> B. The book places handling complexity through experimentation (probe, sense, respond) in the 'value streams and processes' dimension. Medium confidence: the book does not use the exact words 'safe-to-fail'.
corrections.summaryAr: تغيّرت الإجابة من A إلى B (Value streams and processes) حسب الكتاب 2.3.2. ثقة متوسطة.

corrections.summary: Answer key changed A -> B, as for printed #93 (same question).
corrections.summaryAr: تغيّرت الإجابة من A إلى B حسب الكتاب 2.3.2.

corrections.summary: Answer key changed D -> C (owner decision). The book describes projects as time-bound initiatives that introduce new or changed products and services; the dump keys the same question C twice.
corrections.summaryAr: تغيّرت الإجابة من D إلى C بقرار المالك حسب الكتاب 7.3.2.

corrections.summary: Answer key changed D (Operate) -> B (Support). In the book, incident resolution belongs to the 'support' activity.
corrections.summaryAr: تغيّرت الإجابة من Operate إلى Support حسب الكتاب (جدول 4.9).
